_comment: Implementation-sensitivity experiment. This config is separate from
configs/matrix.json so the primary dataset is never touched: it is run
The `defaults` block is a verbatim copy of configs/matrix.json's defaults
(same CPU/memory allocation, keyspace, timeouts, Raft timeouts, seed, and
10 repetitions), so the sensitivity runs use the same benchmark
`implementations` lists every implementation evaluated for each protocol:
raft   -> hashicorp (primary, Raft A), etcd (go.etcd.io/raft/v3, Raft B)
epaxos -> original (primary, EPaxos A), nvb (nvb/epaxos, EPaxos B)
The first run family is the paper's primary baseline (3 replicas, 100%
writes, concurrency 32, 20 s measured phase); the second adds the next
replica count to test the qualitative scaling direction.
The largest replica counts (7, 9) are NOT included: they need ~4.4-5.4 GB
across containers and this host has ~3 GB free, which would starve them
relative to the recorded primary runs.
